name: Accordion
description: Sections that open in place.

name: AccountButton
description: The signed-in user account: avatar, display name, optional email and notification count.

name: ActionBar
description: The entity header's actions (R12.1): the top-priority actions as buttons, the primary right-most, the rest under "More actions ▾".

name: ActionButton
description: A Button that runs an async action and confirms the outcome in place.

name: ActionContextMenu
description: Right-click (long-press, Shift+F10, the Menu key) on a row or card opens exactly the menu its ⋯ button opens (R11.6) — the same definition, the same item parts.

name: ActionMenu
description: The row ⋯ menu (R12.1): a ghost icon button that opens every action for the row.

name: ActionMenuItems
description: The rows of an action menu: groups in the fixed order (R12.2), set apart by space, with one hairline before the destructive group.

name: ActionMenuPreview
description: The same menu drawn statically, for documentation.

name: ActionProvider
description: Supplies the services every action runs with — navigation, toasts, windows and the confirm dialog — and mounts the toast viewport and confirm host they need.

name: ActivityFeed
description: An activity or notification feed using shared relative times and accessible absolute tooltips.

name: AddressField
description: AddressInput bound to an AddressValue form field.

name: AddressInput
description: The address editor on its own (controlled or not).

name: AddressView
description: An address to read, not edit: the postal block in a recessed well with Copy, and optionally its map.

name: AiCard
description: A composable assistant card with header, body and footer slots.

name: AiHero
description: The Assistant landing: the mark and one question, directly on the canvas (R4.6), on the reading column.

name: AiMark
description: The Assistant brand mark.

name: AiStatusStrip
description: The conversation's status strip (R14.6, R17.4): the session stream's connection, the budget and the model, as one caption line under the composer.

name: AiSurfaceProvider
description: Choose the surrounding canvas, panel or floating surface so assistant cards use the appropriate material.

name: AlertDialog
description: A confirmation for destructive or irreversible actions.

name: AlertDialogPreview
description: The alert surface in the page flow, for documentation.

name: AppearanceProvider
description: Provide persisted appearance preferences and synchronize theme, palette, density, motion and typography with the document.

name: ApprovalCard
description: An approval request: the agent wants to run a consequential action.

name: ApprovalRecord
description: The record of a decided approval: one line in the transcript.

name: AppShell
description: Compose application navigation, a top bar and a workspace, with optional section drawer, inspector and phone navigation.

name: AreaChart
description: An area chart: the line chart with its wash (and `stacked` for parts of a total).

name: AskCard
description: Any human-in-the-loop ask by its type.

name: AskDock
description: The ask dock (R13.8): every pending ask in the conversation, pinned directly above the composer until it is answered.

name: AskDockProvider
description: Share pending questions and their resolutions between transcript markers and the interactive question dock.

name: AskLayout
description: The body of an ask: an AiCard (icon tile in the ask's tone, the question as the title, controls, footer with the primary on the right).

name: AskMarker
description: A pending ask's place in the transcript while the ask dock holds it: one line, the same box as the record it becomes, and Review, which brings the ask to the front of the dock and moves focus to it.

name: AskRecord
description: The compact record an ask folds into once it is answered, approved, denied or expired.

name: AskShell
description: Folds an ask into its record: the box animates from the ask's height to the record's (--duration-slow), so resolving never jumps; while the conversation is pinned to the bottom, the content above moves instead of the messages below (see ConversationLog).

name: AssistantMessage
description: An answer: no bubble — the AI mark in the gutter and the blocks on the canvas (or the panel), prose across the reading column and wide blocks breaking out wider.

name: AssistantPane
description: The assistant docked beside a page or opened as a window: a glass pane with the AI mark, the title and the scope it is pinned to, header actions, then the conversation filling the rest.

name: AttachmentChip
description: An attachment in the composer: type glyph, name, size or upload progress, remove.

name: Autocomplete
description: Free text with suggestions as you type: search boxes, hostnames, paths.

name: Avatar
description: A person or account.

name: AvatarGroup
description: Overlapping faces for "who is here" (watchers, active sessions).

name: AvatarSkeleton
description: Placeholder with the avatar's exact box.

name: Badge
description: A soft pill that labels state or category.

name: BarChart
description: Columns and bars: grouped, stacked, and horizontal ranked lists ("top processes by memory").

name: BrandLogo
description: A brand source drawn in its two tones.

name: BrandMark
description: A configured mark by name.

name: Breadcrumb
description: The universal breadcrumb (R6.4): one line at --control-h-sm in the top bar.

name: Button
description: The only button.

name: ButtonGroup
description: The only button.

name: ButtonLink
description: A button-styled link with native navigation and open-in-new-tab behaviour.

name: ByteSizeField
description: ByteSizeInput bound to a `number | null` (bytes) form field.

name: ByteSizeInput
description: A size typed the way people write it — "500 MB", "1.5 GB", "2 GiB" — held as whole bytes and rewritten when focus leaves ("1500 MB" → "1.5 GB").

name: Calendar
description: A month grid for picking a day or a range.

name: ChartFrame
description: The shell every chart renders in.

name: ChartLegend
description: Series identity for two or more series (a single series needs no legend: the title names it).

name: ChartTable
description: Every chart carries its data as a table.

name: ChartTooltip
description: The floating readout for multi-series and per-mark charts: a glass overlay that follows the pointer (or the keyboard cursor) and lists every series at that position — values lead, labels follow, each keyed by a short line of the series colour.

name: Checkbox
description: A box that is ticked, unticked or mixed.

name: CheckboxGroup
description: Several related checkboxes sharing one value array.

name: ChipMeasure
description: A chip-shaped twin used only to measure how many chips fit (no behaviour, hidden).

name: ChipOverflow
description: A compact chip collection with a searchable +N overflow popover.

name: ChoiceRow
description: A checkbox, radio or switch with its own label and description beside it (the controls' `label` prop).

name: CitationMarker
description: A footnote marker in assistant text (`[^2]`): a small numbered pill.

name: ClarifyAsk
description: A free-text clarification: the agent's question, its best guesses as one-tap answers, and a field for anything else.

name: CodeBlock
description: A fenced code block: language label, copy (✓ in place), wrap toggle and optional line numbers.

name: ColumnChart
description: Vertical columns.

name: Combobox
description: Choose exactly one item from a long list by typing.

name: ComboboxPopup
description: The glass list shared by Combobox, MultiSelect and TagInput: a polite live count, the list state (refresh line, first-load skeleton rows, error with Retry, "type more"), the empty row, options (grouped when they name a group) and the "N more" footer.

name: CommandPanel
description: The palette's contents: search field, grouped results and keyboard hints.

name: Composer
description: Where the person writes.

name: ConfirmAsk
description: Yes or no on a consequence the agent spells out.

name: ConfirmHost
description: Renders confirm() requests one at a time.

name: ContextMenu
description: Right-click menus.

name: ConversationHandlersProvider
description: Connect assistant interaction events to host callbacks for answers, approvals, retries, feedback and opening results.

name: ConversationLog
description: The conversation: a scrolling log on a centred reading column, with the composer floating over its bottom edge.

name: CoordinatesField
description: CoordinatesInput bound to a `{ lat, lng } | null` form field.

name: CoordinatesInput
description: Latitude and longitude in one box.

name: CopyButton
description: Copies a value and confirms in place: the icon becomes a drawn ✓ for the feedback hold, or ✕ when the clipboard refuses (R9.2), and a polite announcement says "Copied".

name: CountBadge
description: A number beside a navigation item or group ("Endpoints 12"), or on a corner (overlay).

name: CountryField
description: CountrySelect bound to a `string | null` form field (ISO code).

name: CountryFlag
description: A 3:2 flag the height of an icon.

name: CountrySelect
description: Choose a country by typing its name: every ISO 3166-1 country, named by the platform in the locale, with its flag and code.

name: DataTable
description: The one data table (R16).

name: DateField
description: A calendar day typed in the locale's order ("13/10/2026") or picked from a calendar.

name: DateRangeField
description: A range of calendar days in one box: two typed ends ("1/10/2026 – 13/10/2026") and a range calendar.

name: DateTimeAsk
description: When something should happen: the agent's suggested times as one-tap choices, or an exact date and time, in the stated time zone.

name: DefaultClusterPopup
description: A cluster's contents: the status breakdown and its points, worst first.

name: DesktopSession
description: The live desktop block: the endpoint's screen with a state badge on it, the steps the assistant took and is taking, and a large Stop.

name: DetailGrid
description: Tiles in an auto-fill grid that reflows with its container (R5.5): as many columns as fit at the minimum tile width, never a fixed count.

name: DetailTile
description: One fact about an entity: icon, caption label, value and an optional second line.

name: DetailTileSkeleton
description: The exact box of a one-line DetailTile (plus its detail line when `detail`).

name: Dialog
description: Focused tasks in a glass frame: icon header, one scrolling body, a pinned footer — a bottom sheet on phones.

name: DialogSurface
description: Backdrop + viewport + glass popup, for every modal surface (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, the command palette).

name: Disclosure
description: A single show/hide section with the accordion's row and motion.

name: Dock
description: Everything in the workspace is a window: tiled, floating, snapped, maximised, minimised to the dock or popped out.

name: DomainField
description: DomainInput bound to a string form field.

name: DomainInput
description: A domain ("northstar.example"), lower case; Unicode becomes punycode; a pasted URL gives its host.

name: DonutChart
description: Display a part-to-whole dataset as a ring, with responsive legends, an accessible data table and optional centre content.

name: DrillPathBar
description: Where a drill-down is: the root, each ancestor (each one navigates back) and the current node.

name: DurationField
description: DurationInput bound to a `number | null` (seconds) form field.

name: DurationInput
description: A duration typed the way people say it — "1h 30m", "90", "1:30", "1.5 hours", "2 days" — held as whole seconds and rewritten compactly when focus leaves ("90" → "1h 30m").

name: EmailField
description: EmailInput bound to a string form field, with the typo hint.

name: EmailInput
description: An email address: trimmed, "mailto:" dropped and the domain lower-cased when focus leaves.

name: EmailSuggestion
description: "Did you mean avery@gmail.com?" for the field's message line; choosing it replaces the value.

name: EmptyState
description: What a list, table or pane shows when it has nothing — or failed to load — in the same box the content would have used (R9.1, R16.4).

name: EntityChip
description: A Glass UX entity mentioned by the assistant, the user or the composer: glyph (with the endpoint's live status dot), name, and one data meta (ticket state, version).

name: EntityGlyph
description: The glyph of an entity, with its live status dot when it has one.

name: EntityHeader
description: A responsive page heading for an entity, with identity, status, supporting metadata and host-defined actions.

name: EntityHeaderSkeleton
description: The header's loading state: the same boxes as the loaded header (R9.3).

name: EntityIdentity
description: Present a host-defined entity with its glyph or avatar, readable name and supporting metadata.

name: EntityIdentitySkeleton
description: EntityIdentitySkeleton is part of the entity component family.

name: EntityOptionList
description: The option rows for entity search (the composer's

name: EntityPickerAsk
description: Pick one or more entities: a search field over the application's resolver, the agent's suggestions as the starting list, and the picks as removable chips.

name: EntityPreviewCard
description: The preview card drawn statically, for documentation.

name: EntityPreviewContent
description: The inside of the preview card: identity, state, three or four facts, primary actions.

name: EntityQuickActions
description: Up to `max` promoted actions from the entity's set (R12), as small buttons.

name: EntityResolverProvider
description: Connect entity kinds, names, destinations, previews, search and actions to host-defined adapters.

name: EntitySettingsDialog
description: Every entity's Settings dialog (R12.6, glass-ux-components-plan §5.1): an `lg` dialog whose header is the entity's identity tile with "Settings" and a data subtitle, an L3 tab rail, and Cancel / Save.

name: EntityStateBadge
description: The entity's state as a badge: its live status or its toned state (ticket, alert).

name: FactList
description: A compact semantic description list for popovers, metadata and small summaries.

name: Field
description: Field namespace: `<Field label …>` plus the parts for custom layouts.

name: Fieldset
description: Groups related fields under one legend.

name: FieldSkeleton
description: The loading shape of a Field: a label-role text line, a block of the control's exact height and the reserved message line — the same boxes as the loaded field (R9.3).

name: FileDrop
description: Drop files on the dashed tile, or activate it to browse.

name: FileGlyph
description: The file's type glyph as an element (a static component per type).

name: FileList
description: The list under a FileDrop.

name: FileRow
description: One file in a FileList: name, size and state, a progress bar of fixed height, remove.

name: FileRowItem
description: One downloadable file: type glyph, name, size and type, and a download button.

name: FilterEditor
description: Server-side sorting and pages, columns that fold by priority into “+N” and then cards, resizable and pinned columns, bulk actions and live rows.

name: Form
description: The <form> element for a `useAppForm` instance.

name: FormActions
description: Footer row for a form outside a Panel or Dialog: secondary actions, then Save.

name: FormAsk
description: A short form the agent needs filled (a ticket, a schedule): stacked fields, one per row, capped at the form measure (R15).

name: FormGroup
description: Related rows under an overline label; groups are separated by --gap-section (R15.8).

name: FormStack
description: The single form column (R15.2): one field or setting per row, capped at --form-measure.

name: Gauge
description: A level in a known range — disk 82%, memory, licence seats — as a 270° arc.

name: GenericResult
description: A tool's browser preview (AiToolCallResultPreview) rendered schema-first: the disclosure picks table, detail, value or redaction, and recognised Glass UX types upgrade to entity cards and lists (resolvePreview).

name: GeoMap
description: Points with a status anywhere in the world, clustered with a status ring, over a token-themed vector basemap with the home region glowing in the data hue.

name: GeoMapSkeleton
description: The map's box before anything is known: the same size, a silhouette when the region is.

name: Heatmap
description: Magnitude over two categories — alerts per hour by kind, CPU per hour by endpoint.

name: Highlight
description: `text` with the parts matching `query` emphasised (case- and diacritic-insensitive).

name: Histogram
description: How values spread — check-in latency across the fleet.

name: HitLayer
description: The pointer and keyboard surface over a plot.

name: HostnameField
description: HostnameInput bound to a string form field.

name: HostnameInput
description: A host name: one label ("NST-C106") or a dotted name ("printer.northstar.local").

name: IdentityCell
description: The two-line identity cell: a status-dotted glyph, the name, and a data subtitle.

name: ImageLightbox
description: A lightbox for result images: a dialog with the image on the canvas, previous / next, and zoom (fit, 150 %, 200 %, 300 %); the zoomed image scrolls inside the stage.

name: ImageTile
description: One image in its reserved aspect-ratio box: it never moves anything when it loads.

name: InheritedSetting
description: A setting that can come from a broader level (R6.9): workspace → organisation → site → this entity.

name: InlineCode
description: Inline code inside prose.

name: Input
description: A text field box: `fa-control` with leading icon and trailing unit, keyboard hint, clear button or password reveal.

name: InputSkeleton
description: The loading box of an Input (no label; use Field.Skeleton for a full field).

name: Inspector
description: Docked: a glass pane.

name: InspectorToggle
description: Shows or hides the inspector pane: in Glass UX, the assistant for the current context.

name: IpField
description: IpInput bound to a string form field.

name: IpInput
description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, optionally with a prefix length.

name: JsonTree
description: A read-only JSON viewer for tool arguments and results: collapsible objects and arrays, typed values in the code colours, long arrays paged ("Show 200 more of 1,284") and long strings cut with the full value on hover.

name: Kbd
description: A keyboard shortcut, formatted for the viewer's platform: ⌘K on macOS, Ctrl K elsewhere.

name: LineChart
description: Lines and areas over time — one visual language with Sparkline: the same monotone curve, 2px stroke, gradient wash and ringed end dot, then axes, a legend and a crosshair as the box grows.

name: ListRow
description: A clickable list row sharing the library's item recipe and native keyboard activation.

name: MacAddressField
description: MacAddressInput bound to a string form field.

name: MacAddressInput
description: A MAC address in any notation, written one way when focus leaves the field.

name: MapSilhouette
description: The home region as a static outline, framed exactly like the map's first view: an SVG inset by the fit padding whose viewBox is the framed box (`xMidYMid meet` is fitBounds).

name: MapStatusSummary
description: Status counts as dot · number · label chips (clusters, popups, legends).

name: MapViewToggle
description: "View as list" / "View as map": in the map's controls, and in the list's toolbar.

name: Markdown
description: Assistant prose.

name: Menu
description: Actions in fa-item rows: icon, label, shortcut, submenus, toggles and choices — danger last, disabled rows say why.

name: MenuItemContent
description: The inside of every menu row (menu, context menu, action menus, previews): icon, label, then a trailing shortcut or chevron.

name: MenuPreview
description: Actions in fa-item rows: icon, label, shortcut, submenus, toggles and choices — danger last, disabled rows say why.

name: MessageBlocks
description: An assistant message's blocks in order: reasoning, tool activity, prose, results, asks, notices and sources.

name: MessageSkeleton
description: The boxes of a loading turn, or an assistant-only reply, with stable loaded geometry.

name: Meter
description: A level within a known range: disk, memory, licence seats.

name: MeterCell
description: A responsive table meter: the reading remains when the narrow cell drops its track.

name: MeterSkeleton
description: Same rows and heights as a loaded Meter.

name: Metric
description: A number with its trend — the R7.2 container showcase.

name: MetricSkeleton
description: Every row of the Metric in the same tier geometry, so loading never shifts a pixel.

name: MobileField
description: A mobile number (no extension).

name: MoneyField
description: MoneyInput bound to a `number | null` (minor units) form field.

name: MoneyInput
description: An amount of money held in minor units (integer cents), so totals never drift.

name: MultiChoiceAsk
description: Several items from a list, with Select all.

name: MultiSelect
description: Several choices from a list, shown as chips inside the field.

name: NormalisedInput
description: An Input that tidies its value when focus leaves it, never while typing: the caret is never fought (R15).

name: Notice
description: Information that belongs to a place on the page — always rendered there, never injected (R9.1).

name: NotificationDot
description: A small dot on the corner of an icon button (unread notifications).

name: NumberField
description: A number with bounds and steps: type it, use ↑ ↓ (Shift for large steps), the − / + steppers, or drag the scrub label.

name: NumericCell
description: A number in tabular figures with its unit.

name: OptionChip
description: The one chip used by MultiSelect and TagInput: optional icon, a label that truncates with a tooltip, and a remove button named "Remove …".

name: OptionMore
description: "1,272 more — refine your search", under a truncated result list.

name: OptionRow
description: One option's content: icon, label and description with matches emphasised, meta on the right and an optional ✓ column.

name: OptionStatus
description: The list's state above the options: a thin indeterminate line while results refresh (the previous ones stay), skeleton rows on the first load, an error row with Retry, or a prompt for more characters.

name: OrgAvatar
description: An organisation's avatar: its logo, or its initials on its tint.

name: OrgSwitcher
description: Choose an organisation from a complete local hierarchy or a bounded server directory.

name: OrgSwitcherPanel
description: The switcher's list, always open, for a sheet, a page or the gallery.

name: OtpField
description: OtpInput bound to a string form field.

name: OtpInput
description: A one-time code in N boxes (Base UI OTP Field): autocomplete="one-time-code" so phones offer the code from a message, a numeric keypad, paste fills every box (the code is found inside "Your code is 482913"), Backspace steps back, the arrows move.

name: Pagination
description: The pager that sits in a table's status bar.

name: PaletteProvider
description: Hosts the command palette: a registry of commands contributed by whatever is mounted, ⌘K / Ctrl+K from anywhere to open it, and the registered commands' own shortcuts.

name: Panel
description: The standard content pane: glass-panel, surface radius, header/body/footer slots.

name: PanelBody
description: The content slot of a Panel, with consistent padding and support for a bounded scrolling parent.

name: PanelFooter
description: The supporting content and actions slot at the bottom of a Panel.

name: PanelHeader
description: A Panel heading with an optional icon, description and trailing actions.

name: PasswordField
description: PasswordInput bound to a string form field.

name: PasswordInput
description: A password box (R20): the reveal toggle is an eye button with a tooltip and aria-pressed; a Caps Lock warning appears inside the box while it is on; new passwords get a strength bar and, optionally, Generate and Copy.

name: PercentField
description: PercentInput bound to a `number | null` form field.

name: PercentInput
description: A percentage, 0–100 by default, with the % as a unit and tabular figures.

name: PhoneField
description: PhoneInput bound to a string form field (E.164).

name: PhoneInput
description: A phone number with its country.

name: PieChart
description: Pie and donut: a part-to-whole at a glance (six slices or fewer; the tail folds into "Other").

name: PinMap
description: Points with a status anywhere in the world, clustered with a status ring, over a token-themed vector basemap with the home region glowing in the data hue.

name: PlotSkeleton
description: The plot's placeholder: the chart's own shape in the plot's exact box (R9.3), so swapping in the data moves nothing.

name: PopoutWindow
description: Everything in the workspace is a window: tiled, floating, snapped, maximised, minimised to the dock or popped out.

name: Popover
description: Small, contextual, non-blocking content next to its trigger: a filter, a peek, a short form.

name: PortField
description: PortInput bound to a `number | null` form field.

name: PortInput
description: A TCP or UDP port: whole numbers 1–65535, no grouping ("8080", never "8,080"), and the service usually on it named beside the number.

name: PrivilegedMark
description: A small lock beside the label of a setting that needs MFA to change (PrivilegedWrite, ): reassignment, credentials, routing, removal.

name: Progress
description: A task's progress in place: label and percentage, the bar, then a data line with an optional action.

name: ProgressRing
description: A compact circular progress for inline and icon-sized spots.

name: ProgressSkeleton
description: Same rows and heights as a loaded Progress.

name: ProportionStrip
description: A part-to-whole in one line: the micro tier of pie, donut, treemap and sunburst.

name: ProviderActivity
description: What the model is doing between tool calls: working, waiting on an endpoint, retrying the provider, or searching the web.

name: QuickRepliesAsk
description: Quick replies: a handful of short answers as pills.

name: RadialBar
description: Several levels as concentric 270° rings, outermost first — CPU, memory and disk on one endpoint.

name: Radio
description: One option of a RadioGroup.

name: RadioCard
description: A radio as a tile: title, description and the radio circle.

name: RadioGroup
description: One choice from a few visible options.

name: Rail
description: Compose the primary application navigation rail from accessible items, separators and flexible spacers.

name: RankAsk
description: Put options in order (rollout groups, fallback printers).

name: Reasoning
description: The model's reasoning summary (provider_activity · reasoning_summary), collapsed to one line: "Thought for 4 s".

name: Redacted
description: The withheld treatment: the value is not in the browser; revealing it is a permission.

name: ReferenceInput
description: Link entities to the one being edited, the way the AI composer adds context: type @ (or press Link…) to search people, devices, sites, tickets and documents, pick one, and it becomes a chip.

name: RelativeTime
description: "2 min ago", ticking on a shared clock; the absolute time is in a keyboard-accessible tooltip (R2.7).

name: ResultBlock
description: Render any tool result by its type.

name: ResultChart
description: Assistant result adapted into the shared chart family, with stable series and keyboard/table access.

name: ResultDetail
description: Key–value facts as DetailTiles in a DetailGrid that reflows with the card.

name: ResultDiff
description: A change preview — config, registry or policy — as a unified diff: removed lines on the danger tint, added lines on the success tint, the sign in the gutter so the change reads without colour too.

name: ResultEntities
description: A list of entities as compact rows: glyph with status, name (a context link), a data detail, the state, and the row ⋯ menu — with the same menu on right-click (R11.6).

name: ResultEntity
description: One entity as a card: its glyph and live state, the data subtitle, a few facts and the entity's own actions (R12: ActionBar from the same definition as its page header).

name: ResultFiles
description: Files the agent produced (GlassUxAiShareFile) or collected, ready to download.

name: ResultFrame
description: The frame every tool-rendered result shares: an AiCard on the breakout column with a compact header — glyph, title, data meta (source · count) — and the same three actions in the same order: copy, export CSV, open in window.

name: ResultImages
description: Screenshots and remote previews.

name: ResultJson
description: The last resort: the preview as a JSON tree.

name: ResultLog
description: Log or terminal output: time, a level word in its tone (the same roles as badges), and the message in monospace.

name: ResultMetrics
description: Key figures from a tool: Metric tiles (src/ui/metric) in an auto-fill grid.

name: ResultSkeleton
description: The exact box of a result before its data arrives: the same card, header and body shape (row count, chart height, image ratio), so the result replaces it without moving anything below (R9.3).

name: ResultTable
description: A table result: the first rows inline in the AI table style, columns stepping away by priority as the card narrows, and rows becoming a compact list in very narrow cards.

name: ResultValue
description: A single figure or short text from a tool (a count, a state), or a withheld preview.

name: RichTextField
description: Markdown input bound to a string form field, with Field label and reserved validation.

name: RichTextInput
description: A Markdown document with an editable visual view and optional source view.

name: RichTextSkeleton
description: The editor's adaptive toolbar and empty content geometry while the engine or document loads.

name: RouteBreadcrumb
description: The universal breadcrumb with router links — what the shell renders from route matches.

name: RouteTabs
description: L2 tabs as routes — the default (R6.2).

name: RouteVerticalTabs
description: L3 sections as routes — the default (R6.2): `/settings/security/sessions`.

name: ScatterChart
description: Two measures per item — CPU against memory for every endpoint.

name: ScrollArea
description: A scrolling region with thin glass scrollbars that appear while you hover or scroll, and `data-scrolled-top|bottom|left|right` on the root for edge treatments.

name: SearchField
description: Search box: magnifier, clear button while filled, Esc clears, optional ⌘K hint for the top bar.

name: SearchTrigger
description: The command search field.

name: SecretField
description: SecretInput bound to a form field holding a `SecretValue`: use it inside `form.AppField`.

name: SecretInput
description: A write-only secret (BR notes): a stored value is never shown, only "Set", with Replace and Clear.

name: SectionDrawer
description: Compose a section navigation drawer with header, search, groups, items, body and footer slots.

name: Segmented
description: One of two to five mutually exclusive modes ("Enabled | Disabled", "List | Grid", "RMM · PSA · CHAT").

name: Select
description: Pick one option from a short, known list.

name: Separator
description: A hairline.

name: SessionNav
description: The Assistant section drawer's content: New chat, search, the two views (conversations, archived) with counts, projects, and the sessions grouped by day.

name: SessionNavSkeleton
description: The session list's loading rows: overline and title rows in their final box.

name: SettingRow
description: One setting on one line: label (with an optional value and badge) and description on the left, the control right-aligned.

name: SettingRowSkeleton
description: A setting row's loading shape: label and description lines and the control's box.

name: SettingsDialog
description: The settings pattern (R13.2): header with icon tile, title and a data subtitle; an L3 rail of sections beside a scrolling pane; a pinned footer.

name: SettingsSections
description: The rail + pane body of a settings dialog.

name: Sheet
description: A glass pane from a screen edge: the inspector (right), the section drawer (left) or a short list of choices (bottom).

name: ShellBrand
description: The product mark in the top-left corner, centred over the rail: the home link.

name: ShortcutKeys
description: The keys of a shortcut, as keycaps: "g e" → G E; "mod+k" → Ctrl K.

name: SingleChoiceAsk
description: One choice from a few options, each with a sentence: radio cards that reflow by width.

name: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders for text, blocks, avatars and compound content that preserve the loaded layout.

name: Slider
description: A value (or a range) on a track.

name: SourceList
description: The sources behind an answer: numbered to match the markers in the text, with the site or the Glass UX record each came from.

name: SourcesProvider
description: Make a message's sources available to the citation markers in its text.

name: Sparkline
description: A single-series line that fills its box: smooth (monotone, no overshoot), 2px whatever the size, a wash of the data colour beneath and a ringed dot on the latest point.

name: SparklineCell
description: The shared Sparkline at row size plus its current value, right-aligned in tabular figures.

name: SparklineSkeleton
description: Placeholder for a sparkline's box.

name: StatusBadge
description: An endpoint's state as a badge.

name: StatusDot
description: The bare status dot: tree rows, dock icons, avatar presence, table cells.

name: StatusGlyph
description: The status glyph shared by tool rows, groups and provider activity.

name: SuggestionChips
description: Prompt suggestions as glass pills: one tap puts the prompt in the composer.

name: Sunburst
description: Rings of a hierarchy around its centre — DaisyDisk for disk usage.

name: Surface
description: A piece of glass.

name: Swatch
description: The swatch alone: identity is a coloured mark beside text, never coloured text.

name: SwatchPicker
description: One colour from a small set (a palette, an organisation's tint): round swatches in a recessed track, each named by a tooltip.

name: Switch
description: On or off, applied immediately.

name: SystemNotice
description: A change to the conversation itself (scope switched, context added, model changed).

name: TabBar
description: Compose primary application navigation for a narrow viewport, with labelled items and active-state feedback.

name: TableScroll
description: The scroll box around an AI table: horizontal scroll for wide tables, vertical scroll past `maxRows` with the header stuck, and the scrolled-edge hairlines (R5.8).

name: TabNav
description: The same strip as `Tabs.List` for tabs that are places (R6.2: routes by default).

name: Tabs
description: L2 navigation: icon tabs with a sliding accent underline.

name: TabsSkeleton
description: Placeholder strip with the same height and rhythm as the real tabs.

name: TagInput
description: Free-entry chips: email recipients, IP addresses, labels.

name: TestButton
description: Test a connection without leaving the dialog (§5.1): the button confirms in place (pending, then ✓ or ✕ with a shake) and a reserved line beside it says why.

name: Textarea
description: Multi-line text.

name: TextareaSkeleton
description: The loading box of a Textarea at `rows` (its minRows).

name: TextCell
description: Single-line text that truncates with an ellipsis; the full text appears on hover.

name: ThemeToggle
description: Quick light/dark switch, for products that want it in the bar.

name: TimerChip
description: A running timer in the top bar: "0:42 · #4821", shown only while it runs (R5.2).

name: TimeZoneField
description: TimeZoneSelect bound to a `string | null` form field (IANA name).

name: TimeZoneSelect
description: Choose an IANA time zone by typing a city or region ("hobart", "new york").

name: Toaster
description: The toast viewport: bottom-right on desktop, top on phones (R13.6).

name: ToastLayout
description: The inside of a toast.

name: ToastPreview
description: A static toast for documentation.

name: ToneDot
description: A tone-keyed state marker without an application-specific status vocabulary.

name: ToolCallRow
description: One tool call as a quiet row: status glyph, a human verb ("Queried 1,284 endpoints"), its targets, and the elapsed time.

name: ToolCallSkeleton
description: The exact row box of a tool call while history loads.

name: ToolGroup
description: Consecutive tool calls folded into one summary row ("Ran 4 tools · 2.3 s"), with the running and failed counts when there are any.

name: Tooltip
description: A short label for a control, shown on hover and keyboard focus after 500ms.

name: TooltipBody
description: The standard tooltip body: a heading (the x or category), then one row per series.

name: TooltipPopup
description: Portal + positioner + the inverted glass bubble.

name: TooltipPreview
description: A static tooltip bubble for documentation and screenshots.

name: TooltipProvider
description: Groups tooltips: the first opens after 500ms, its neighbours open instantly while the pointer moves along a toolbar.

name: TopBar
description: A responsive application header combining scope, breadcrumb, search, status, account and host-defined actions.

name: TopBarSettingsButton
description: The product's settings (Glass UX settings: the workspace dialog), an application-level gear.

name: TopologyCanvas
description: A pannable, zoomable tree map: a gateway, its switches and access points, then clients in blocks by kind, with link speeds where known and unknown links dashed.

name: TopologyCanvasSkeleton
description: The whole canvas while there is nothing to give it yet (no label, no nodes): the same box and loading shape.

name: TopologySkeleton
description: The canvas's loading shape: a root, a row of three, a row of clusters (R9.3).

name: TopologyViewToggle
description: "View as list" / "View as map": in the map's controls, and in the list's toolbar.

name: Tree
description: The navigation tree (the sidebar's endpoints by organisation).

name: Treemap
description: Nested rectangles sized by value — SpaceMonger/WinDirStat for disk usage.

name: TreeSkeleton
description: Placeholder rows with exactly the tree's row heights, icon boxes and text roles.

name: TruncatedText
description: One line of text that ends in an ellipsis when it does not fit, and shows the full text in a tooltip only when it was actually cut (R8.1).

name: Turn
description: One prompt and its answers.

name: TurnNavigator
description: Jump between prompts on wide screens: a column of dashes beside the log, one per turn.

name: TwoLineCell
description: Two stacked lines: a value and a data subtitle ("Windows 11 Business" / "10.0.26300").

name: UrlField
description: UrlInput bound to a string form field.

name: UrlInput
description: A web address.

name: UserMessage
description: A prompt: a compact glass-control bubble on the right, attachments above it, and edit and copy below on hover or focus (always on touch).

name: VerticalTabNav
description: Route navigation for sections, with an active location indicator and responsive rail, chip and picker layouts.

name: VerticalTabs
description: L3 navigation: a section rail that becomes chips, or a picker past six sections, in narrow containers.

name: Window
description: Slots for window bodies.

name: WindowBodySkeleton
description: The loading state of a window body: the scroll body's padding and a few lines.

name: WindowContentHost
description: Loads and renders a window's body.

name: WindowFrame
description: Everything in the workspace is a window: tiled, floating, snapped, maximised, minimised to the dock or popped out.

name: WindowManagerProvider
description: Provide a window manager to the tree and connect it (load the persisted layout, join cross-tab sync) before the first paint after hydration.

name: WindowScopeChip
description: The scope chip in a window's app bar: the organisation's avatar and name, shown only when the window belongs to a scope other than the current one.

name: WindowScopeProvider
description: Everything in the workspace is a window: tiled, floating, snapped, maximised, minimised to the dock or popped out.

name: WindowSwitcher
description: Phones: every open window in a bottom sheet, plus the routed view.

name: Workspace
description: Everything in the workspace is a window: tiled, floating, snapped, maximised, minimised to the dock or popped out.
